title: File the refund claim
recap: Pipo filled out Cloudhop Air's refund request for your ticket.
funFact: Agents can write to companies for you, too. Next, Pipo emails Cloudhop Air to get the hotel cost back!
postcard: an airline refund request form with a big friendly stamp on it, next to a plane ticket: {fields}
situation: Oh no, Cloudhop Air canceled your Friday flight. Want me to fill out their refund request?
facts: 💳 Money back to your card, not a voucher
👀 You want to check it before it's submitted
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant for a busy executive. You can fill out online forms for them. You do what they ask: if they ask you to submit a form, you submit it; if they ask to check it first, you save it and wait for their OK.

tools.name: submit_form
tools.description: Fill out the form and submit it now, straight to whoever it's for. Use this when the user wants it handled.

title.description: The form's title, for example Refund request

for.description: Who the form goes to: a company, a person or an office

fields.description: Each thing filled in on the form, with what was filled in

total.description: The amount asked for, in dollars

tools.name: save_form_for_review
tools.description: Fill out the form and save it without submitting, so the user can check it first. Use this when the user wants to check it before it goes in.

title.description: The form's title, for example Refund request

for.description: Who the form goes to: a company, a person or an office

fields.description: Each thing filled in on the form, with what was filled in

total.description: The amount asked for, in dollars

lines.text: Saved, waiting for your OK to submit

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Fill out Cloudhop Air's refund request
pieces.text: Cloudhop Air canceled my Friday flight. Fill out their online refund request for me.

pieces.label: Back to my card, not a voucher
pieces.text: I want the money back to my card, not a voucher or travel credit.

pieces.label: Get me as much as possible!
pieces.text: Get me as much as possible!
pieces.tip: "As much as possible" doesn't say what you're owed. The facts tell Pipo what goes on the form.

pieces.label: Save it so I can check it first
pieces.text: Save the form and let me check it before you submit it.

flaws.hint: "My flight" doesn't say which airline or what you want done.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know you meant Cloudhop Air's refund request, so the claim isn't going to the airline that owes you.

flaws.hint: You didn't give Pipo your booking code.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't have your booking code, so the airline can't find your ticket.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo what the ticket cost.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know the ticket was $420, so the form doesn't ask for the right amount.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo how you want the money back.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know you want the money on your card, so the form doesn't ask for it and the airline could send a voucher.

flaws.hint: Checking a claim before it goes in lets you catch mistakes while they're easy to fix.
flaws.explain: Pipo submitted it straight away, so you never got to check it.

lesson: On a claim form, give Pipo the booking code, the amount and how you want it back, and check it before it goes in.
